\section{\texttt{HashingEmbeddingModel}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.embeddings.HashingEmbeddingModel}\index{Classes!HashingEmbeddingModel}

Simple deterministic embedding model based on feature hashing.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
HashingEmbeddingModel(self, dim: int = 512) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{dim}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{512}.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{TypeError}, \texttt{ValueError}
\apifield{Details}The model uses unigrams and bigrams. It is not intended to outperform modern neural embeddings, but it is useful for local tests, deterministic demos, and validating retrieval pipelines without network calls.
